crossRefs.note: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!
“Come now, and let’s reason together,” says Yahweh: “Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow.…
Hear Yahweh’s word, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel!
Yahweh says, “What unrighteousness have your fathers found in me, that they have gone far from me, and have walked…
“Therefore I will yet contend with you,” says Yahweh, “and I will contend with your children’s children.
Listen now to what Yahweh says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to…
I am Yahweh, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice, and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among…
and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests, and a holy nation.’ These are the words which you shall speak to the…
You have declared today that Yahweh is your God, and that you would walk in his ways, keep his statutes, his…
Yahweh has declared today that you are a people for his own possession, as he has promised you, and that you should…
For Yahweh will not forsake his people for his great name’s sake, because it has pleased Yahweh to make you a people…
“Now therefore write this song for yourselves, and teach it to the children of Israel. Put it in their mouths, that…
Yet Yahweh testified to Israel, and to Judah, by every prophet, and every seer, saying, “Turn from your evil ways, and…
and testified against them, that you might bring them again to your law. Yet they were arrogant, and didn’t listen to…
Yet many years you put up with them, and testified against them by your Spirit through your prophets. Yet they would…
I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers…
“I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
Therefore Yahweh his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria. They struck him, and carried away from him a…
Tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In the day when I chose Israel, and swore to the offspring of the house of Jacob…
I said to them, ‘Each of you throw away the abominations of his eyes. Don’t defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt.…
I am Yahweh your God. Walk in my statutes, keep my ordinances, and do them.
Make my Sabbaths holy. They shall be a sign between me and you, that you may know that I am Yahweh your God.’
I will bring the third part into the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will test them like gold is…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.
translations.bsb: “Hear, O My people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will testify against you: I am God, your God.
translations.kjv: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, even thy God.
translations.asv: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify unto thee: I am God, even thy God.
